title: lookup picker: the select badges in an option's preview line are cut to one letter ("A.", "P...")
body:
Filing gate: **① a user-visible UX defect with a named landing point and a reproduction** (`pm:queue` class).
Reader: the objectui lane owning `packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx` — the fix PR there.
Dedupe (open AND closed, semantic search on objectstack-ai/objectui): "lookup picker option preview badge truncated" → 4 hits (#11814, #11889, #9074, #2125); none covers this item.

reach: measured in the console UX walkthrough — stock showcase with `--seed-admin`, framework objectstack-ai/objectstack@54159fd742e5, console pin objectui@12dc7b47c340 (dist stamp equal to the pin), Chromium at 1440x900; re-checked against objectui main source at df943a2a1af3 when found and ed28057 when split (the cited files are unchanged between the two).
type: Bug

Split out of #13115 (item 2), which folded fifteen independent defects into one card under the per-fire filing quota, which the maintainer has since ruled does not bind a concentrated test run such as a walkthrough. Split by the 18.0 QA wave dispatch session `session_01CfRDy7SuTfUqaTu2AEH2Hi`, on the maintainer's instruction there, verbatim: 「#13115 你可以拆」.

## Where

Showcase → Projects → New → Account → open the picker.

## Actual

Each option's preview line reads "Lifecycle: A. · Industry: Tec... · Annual Revenue: $96,00..." — the badge for Active is "A.", Prospect is "P...", Healthcare "He...".

## Expected

A badge either shows its whole label or the preview drops it; a one-letter badge is unreadable.

## Source

`packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx` — `previewOf`: every preview column is a `min-w-0 truncate` span, so the badges rendered by `renderLookupColumnValue` shrink to their first glyph.
